main_output.content: After a 13-year legal battle, Tenny Joppan, the former PA to Oommen Chandy, has been acquitted in the solar fraud case. He maintains he was framed to politically target Chandy and alleges physical assault by former IG Hemachandran during interrogation.

The Kerala government has clarified that the reference to a ₹10,000 crore investment under 'Mission Samudra' refers to the total potential investment across various maritime projects, rather than a single contract with the Tata Group.

KSU State President Aloysius Xavier defended his interaction with the Kerala CM as professional courtesy, emphasizing his commitment to student politics while acknowledging internal friction regarding recent government pleader appointments.

The SIT investigating alleged financial irregularities in the Ayodhya Ram Mandir trust fund is requesting more time to finalize their report, while current investigations have already led to the recovery of ₹80 lakh and the arrest of eight individuals.

Minister Roji M. John defended the independence of administrative decisions in government pleader appointments, dismissing criticism from youth organizations like the KSU while announcing future reforms for KEAM 2026.

Opposition leader V.D. Satheesan faced controversy after video footage showed him appearing to ignore KSU State President Aloysius Xavier at a college event, fueling reports of tension between the opposition leader and the student organization.

Activist Sonam Wangchuk continues his indefinite hunger strike at Jantar Mantar, now in its 20th day, demanding the resignation of the Education Minister over alleged exam irregularities, despite concerns over his deteriorating health.

secondary_output.para_content: Prime Minister Narendra Modi, while inaugurating India's first hydrogen train in Haryana, touted his forward-thinking decision-making and the rapid electrification of the Indian railway network as crucial steps toward achieving energy independence amidst global fuel crises.

incidentList.content: പ്രധാനമന്ത്രി നരേന്ദ്ര മോദി ഹരിയാണയിൽ വെച്ച് ഇന്ത്യയുടെ ആദ്യത്തെ ഹൈഡ്രജൻ ട്രെയിൻ ഉദ്ഘാടനം ചെയ്തു. കഴിഞ്ഞ 12 വർഷത്തിനിടെ റെയിൽവേ ശൃംഖലയുടെ 99 ശതമാനവും വൈദ്യുതീകരിച്ചത് ആഗോള ഊർജ്ജ പ്രതിസന്ധികളെ അതിജീവിക്കാൻ ഇന്ത്യയെ സഹായിച്ചെന്ന് അദ്ദേഹം അവകാശപ്പെട്ടു.
